blurb.en: Analogue dual function generator with a VCA per channel. Envelope, slew or LFO out of the same ten HP.

pull.q: Their sound is clean and free of clipping. Used as envelopes, the function generators are ideal for crisp, percussive sounds.

quotes.t: Features such as shapeable attack and decay curves, slew inputs and EOC outs complete the outstanding overall impression.
